content: Plan for Phase 76 (field fixes): docs/phases/field-fixes.md @ c9d9d37 on branch phase-76-field-fixes. Three logged defects, still on main @ b5cfaa4: (1) a roadmap heading's trailing (slug) / (`slug`) becomes the phase slug under a strict kebab-case rule, through one helper shared by parse_roadmap and validate_identities. Blast radius measured over 43 registered projects: Liminal 21 and perfalyzer 6 headings change; neither is on a changed slug or in a roadmap run. (2) lead_chat._state_line: an empty turn renders as 'turn —' and the result is shown as 'status done (approved)'. (3) iTerm2: poll each tab's session.path (confirmed live to work without shell integration) before launch, re-send the cd once, and fail session start loudly if a tab is still elsewhere; an unreadable path gives a note and continues. Launch lines become 'cd <dir> && cmd'. Terminal.app is out of scope (never observed). Points to challenge: the strictness of the slug rule, and fail vs. warn on a wrong-directory tab.

Approved. Reviewed the plan against roadmap parsing/identity validation, lead_chat._state_line, iTerm2 session creation, existing tests, and both issue notes. The strict trailing-slug rule and shared identity helper are coherent; the measured compatibility check and duplicate-slug coverage address the identity change. Failing before any launch on a confirmed wrong directory is appropriate, and the quoted cd-and-command launch line supports the unavailable-path fallback. The planned fake-I/O cases and live scratch-project check cover the reported startup race. No tests run for this plan review.
